description: This file defines a React functional component named Sidebar for a note-taking application. It utilizes local state management via a custom store (useNotesStore) to display a list of notes, handle note creation, and indicate the selected note. The component renders a sidebar UI with a header, a button to create new notes, and a list of existing notes with navigation links.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: React functional component rendering the sidebar UI for notes, handling note creation and display.
